tools.name: diagnose-data
tools.description: Something isn't working? Show me the problematic data. I will identify likely formatting problems and point to the deterministic Janitor tool that can fix them.

tools.name: normalize-whitespace
tools.description: Collapse repeated whitespace to one space and trim leading/trailing whitespace.

tools.name: safe-filename
tools.description: Convert a string into a Windows-safe filename, including reserved device-name protection.

tools.name: normalize-decimal
tools.description: Normalize common US/EU decimal representations to a dot-decimal string. Ambiguous single separators followed by three digits are flagged.

tools.name: detect-delimiter
tools.description: Detect comma, semicolon, tab, or pipe delimiters across up to 20 non-empty rows while ignoring delimiters inside double quotes.

tools.name: normalize-boolean
tools.description: Normalize common boolean representations such as yes/no, on/off, 1/0, true/false.
